title: React Router Complete Cheat Sheet
description: Comprehensive quick reference for React Router v5 and v6: routing, navigation, parameters, nested routes, guards, data loading, and hooks.

Router Setup — basename
data.code:
// Set a basename if your app is served from a subdirectory.

<BrowserRouter basename="/app">
  <Routes>
    <Route path="/dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />
  </Routes>
</BrowserRouter>

// URL: /app/dashboard

Basic Routes (v6) — Index Route
data.code:
// Render an index route at the parent's URL using index prop.

<Route path="/" element={<Layout />}>
  <Route index element={<Home />} />
  <Route path="about" element={<About />} />
</Route>

data.title: Basic Routes (v6) — path="*" Wildcard
data.code:
// Use path="*" as a catch-all route (404 page).

<Routes>
  <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
  <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
  <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
</Routes>

data.title: Basic Routes (v5) — Switch Component
data.code:
// In v5, Switch renders the first child Route that matches.

import { Switch, Route } from 'react-router-dom';

<Switch>
  <Route exact path="/" component={Home} />
  <Route path="/about" component={About} />
  <Route component={NotFound} />
</Switch>

Nested Routes — Relative Paths
data.code:
// Inside nested routes, use relative paths.

<Route path="/dashboard" element={<Dashboard />}>
  <Route path="stats" element={<Stats />} />
  <Route path="settings" element={<Settings />} />
</Route>

// Link to relative path
<Link to="stats">Stats</Link> // resolves to /dashboard/stats
<Link to="..">Back to root</Link> // resolves to /
